title: Object type
description: A type of objects that the package defines (schema/object-types/<name without namespace>.json). Packages that require the package ship objects of the type below objects/<package>/<type without namespace>/.

content.description: A structure of the package that describes the content of every object of the type.

behavior.description: A class of the package that implements /TRBASE/OBJECT_TYPE_BEHAVIOR: it checks objects of the type and learns about their changes.
